an8.69:1.3: Khattiyaparisā, brāhmaṇaparisā, gahapatiparisā, samaṇaparisā, Cātummahārājikaparisā, Tāvatiṃsaparisā, Māraparisā, Brahmaparisā. 3.
an8.69:1.4: Abhijānāmi kho panāhaṃ bhikkhave anekasataṃ khattiyaparisaṃ upasaṅkamitvā.
an8.69:1.5: Tatra pi mayā sannisinnapubbañ c' eva sallapitapubbañ ca sākacchā ca samāpannapubbā,
an8.69:1.6: tattha yādisako tesaṃ vaṇṇo hoti, tādisako mayhaṃ vaṇṇo hoti, yādisako tesaṃ saro hoti, tādisako mayhaṃ saro hoti,
an8.69:1.7: dhammiyā ca kathāya sandassemi samādapemi samuttejemi sampahaṃsemi,
an8.69:1.9: ‘ko nu kho ayaṃ bhāsati devo vā manusso vā' ti?
an8.69:1.10: Dhammiyā ca kathāya sandassetvā samādapetvā samuttejetvā sampahaṃsetvā antaradhāyāmi,
an8.69:1.12: ‘ko nu kho ayaṃ antarahito devo vā manusso vā' ti? 4.
